passages.text: Then all the Israelites from Dan to Beersheba and from the land of Gilead came out, and the congregation assembled as one man before the LORD at Mizpah.
passages.sermon:
All the Israelites came out.
They came from Dan.
They came from Beersheba.
They came from the land of Gilead.
They gathered together as one group.
They assembled before the LORD.
They met at Mizpah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצְאוּ֮ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַתִּקָּהֵ֨ל הָעֵדָ֜ה כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֗ד לְמִדָּן֙ וְעַד־ בְּאֵ֣ר שֶׁ֔בַע וְאֶ֖רֶץ הַגִּלְעָ֑ד אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה הַמִּצְפָּֽה׃

passages.text: The leaders of all the people and all the tribes of Israel presented themselves in the assembly of God’s people: 400,000 men on foot, armed with swords.
passages.sermon:
The leaders stood before the people.
All the tribes of Israel gathered together.
They met as the assembly of God’s people.
There were 400,000 men present.
All these men were on foot.
All these men carried swords.
passages.original: וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֞וּ פִּנּ֣וֹת כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם כֹּ֚ל שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּקְהַ֖ל עַ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֥ישׁ רַגְלִ֖י שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חָֽרֶב׃פ

passages.text: (Meanwhile the Benjamites heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.) And the Israelites asked, “Tell us, how did this wicked thing happen?”
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin heard news.
They heard that the Israelites had gone up to Mizpah.
The Israelites gathered at Mizpah.
The Israelites spoke together.
They asked a question.
They said, “Tell us how this wicked thing happened.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּֽי־ עָל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּבְּר֕וּ אֵיכָ֥ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

passages.text: So the Levite, the husband of the murdered woman, answered: “I and my concubine came to Gibeah in Benjamin to spend the night.
passages.sermon:
The Levite spoke.
He was the husband of the murdered woman.
He said, “I came to Gibeah.
Gibeah belongs to the tribe of Benjamin.
My concubine came with me.
We came to spend the night there.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַן הָאִ֣ישׁ הַלֵּוִ֗י אִ֛ישׁ הָאִשָּׁ֥ה הַנִּרְצָחָ֖ה וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הַגִּבְעָ֙תָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן בָּ֛אתִי אֲנִ֥י וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖י לָלֽוּן׃

passages.text: And during the night, the men of Gibeah rose up against me and surrounded the house. They intended to kill me, but they abused my concubine, and she died.
passages.sermon:
The men of Gibeah attacked me at night.
They surrounded the house where I was staying.
They wanted to kill me.
They abused my concubine.
My concubine died.
passages.original: וַיָּקֻ֤מוּ עָלַי֙ בַּעֲלֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֔ה וַיָּסֹ֧בּוּ עָלַ֛י אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת לָ֑יְלָה אוֹתִי֙ דִּמּ֣וּ לַהֲרֹ֔ג וְאֶת־ פִּילַגְשִׁ֥י עִנּ֖וּ וַתָּמֹֽת׃

passages.text: Then I took my concubine, cut her into pieces, and sent her throughout the land of Israel’s inheritance, because they had committed a lewd and disgraceful act in Israel.
passages.sermon:
The Levite was the husband of the murdered woman.
He took his concubine.
He cut her into pieces.
He sent her pieces throughout all the territory of Israel.
The men of Gibeah had committed a wicked and shameful act in Israel.
passages.original: וָֽאֹחֵ֤ז בְּפִֽילַגְשִׁי֙ וָֽאֲנַתְּחֶ֔הָ וָֽאֲשַׁלְּחֶ֔הָ בְּכָל־ שְׂדֵ֖ה נַחֲלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י עָשׂ֛וּ זִמָּ֥ה וּנְבָלָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Behold, all you Israelites, give your advice and verdict here and now.”
passages.sermon:
All you Israelites, listen.
You are the sons of Israel.
Give your advice now.
Give your decision now.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֥ה כֻלְּכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם דָּבָ֥ר וְעֵצָ֖ה הֲלֹֽם׃

passages.text: Then all the people stood as one man and said, “Not one of us will return to his tent or to his house.
passages.sermon:
All the people of Israel stood up together.
They acted as one united group.
They said, “No one will go back to his tent.
No one will return to his house.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֙קָם֙ כָּל־ הָעָ֔ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א נֵלֵךְ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְאָהֳל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א נָס֖וּר אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Now this is what we will do to Gibeah: We will go against it as the lot dictates.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gathered together.
They decided to act against the city of Gibeah.
They said, “This is what we will do to Gibeah.”
“We will attack Gibeah.”
“We will decide how to attack by casting lots.”
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לַגִּבְעָ֑ה עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּגוֹרָֽל׃

passages.text: We will take ten men out of every hundred from all the tribes of Israel, and a hundred out of every thousand, and a thousand out of every ten thousand, to supply provisions for the army when they go to Gibeah in Benjamin to punish them for the atrocity they have committed in Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel gathered together.
They decided to act as one group.
They chose men from every tribe of Israel.
They took ten men out of every hundred.
They took one hundred men out of every thousand.
They took one thousand men out of every ten thousand.
These men would gather supplies for the people.
The people would go to Gibeah in the tribe of Benjamin.
They would punish Gibeah for the evil done in Israel.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֣חְנוּ עֲשָׂרָה֩ אֲנָשִׁ֨ים לַמֵּאָ֜ה לְכֹ֣ל׀ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵאָ֤ה לָאֶ֙לֶף֙ וְאֶ֣לֶף לָרְבָבָ֔ה לָקַ֥חַת צֵדָ֖ה לָעָ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת לְבוֹאָם֙ לְגֶ֣בַע בִּנְיָמִ֔ן כְּכָל־ הַ֨נְּבָלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So all the men of Israel gathered as one man, united against the city.
passages.sermon:
All the men of Israel gathered together.
They came to the city.
They stood united.
They acted as one man.
They joined together as friends.
passages.original: וַיֵּֽאָסֵ֞ף כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד חֲבֵרִֽים׃פ

passages.text: And the tribes of Israel sent men throughout the tribe of Benjamin, saying, “What is this wickedness that has occurred among you?
passages.sermon:
The tribes of Israel acted together.
They sent men to every part of the tribe of Benjamin.
These men carried a message.
They said to the people of Benjamin, "What is this evil that has happened among you?"
passages.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֞וּ שִׁבְטֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים בְּכָל־ שִׁבְטֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֚ה הָרָעָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Hand over the wicked men of Gibeah so we can put them to death and purge Israel of this evil.” But the Benjamites refused to heed the voice of their fellow Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The tribes of Israel spoke to the tribe of Benjamin.
They said, “Give us the wicked men in Gibeah.
These men have done evil.
We will put them to death.
We will remove this evil from Israel.”
The Benjamites refused to listen to their fellow Israelites.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה תְּנוּ֩ אֶת־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֨ים בְּנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּ֜עַל אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּגִּבְעָה֙ וּנְמִיתֵ֔ם וּנְבַעֲרָ֥ה רָעָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֤א אָבוְֵּ֣֙ בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לִשְׁמֹ֕עַ בְּק֖וֹל אֲחֵיהֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And from their cities they came together at Gibeah to go out and fight against the Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The men of the tribe of Benjamin gathered together.
They came from their cities.
They assembled at Gibeah.
They prepared to go out to battle.
They planned to fight against the Israelites.
passages.original: וַיֵּאָסְפ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֛ן מִן־ הֶעָרִ֖ים הַגִּבְעָ֑תָה לָצֵ֥את לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: On that day the Benjamites mobilized 26,000 swordsmen from their cities, in addition to the 700 select men of Gibeah.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin gathered their fighting men on that day.
They came from their cities.
They counted 26,000 men who could use a sword.
These men were ready for battle.
There were also 700 chosen men from Gibeah.
These 700 men were in addition to the 26,000 swordsmen.
passages.original: וַיִּתְפָּֽקְדוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֜ן בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב לְ֠בַד מִיֹּשְׁבֵ֤י הַגִּבְעָה֙ הִתְפָּ֣קְד֔וּ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֥ישׁ בָּחֽוּר׃

passages.text: Among all these soldiers there were 700 select left-handers, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair without missing.
passages.sermon:
There were 700 select men among all these soldiers.
Each of these men was left-handed.
Each man could sling a stone with great skill.
Each man could hit even a single hair with a stone.
None of them would miss.
passages.original: מִכֹּ֣ל׀ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה שְׁבַ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ אִ֣ישׁ בָּח֔וּר אִטֵּ֖ר יַד־ יְמִינ֑וֹ כָּל־ זֶ֗ה קֹלֵ֧עַ בָּאֶ֛בֶן אֶל־ הַֽשַּׂעֲרָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יַחֲטִֽא׃פ

passages.text: The Israelites, apart from Benjamin, mobilized 400,000 swordsmen, each one an experienced warrior.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites gathered for battle.
They did not include the tribe of Benjamin.
They mobilized 400,000 men.
Each man carried a sword.
Every one of these men was an experienced warrior.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הִתְפָּֽקְד֗וּ לְבַד֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן אַרְבַּ֨ע מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ שֹׁ֣לֵֽף חָ֑רֶב כָּל־ זֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: The Israelites set out, went up to Bethel, and inquired of God, “Who of us shall go up first to fight against the Benjamites?” “Judah will be first,” the LORD replied.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a group of people.
They set out together.
They went up to Bethel.
They inquired of God.
They asked God a question.
They said, “Who among us should go up first to fight against the Benjamites?”
The LORD answered them.
The LORD said, “Judah will go first.”
passages.original: וַיָּקֻ֜מוּ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בֵֽית־ אֵל֮ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֣וּ בֵאלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ֚י יַעֲלֶה־ לָּ֣נוּ בַתְּחִלָּ֔ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה יְהוּדָ֥ה בַתְּחִלָּֽה׃

passages.text: The next morning the Israelites set out and camped near Gibeah.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a group of people from Israel.
They woke up in the morning.
They got up early that day.
They traveled together.
They went to a place called Gibeah.
They set up their camp near Gibeah.
passages.original: וַיָּק֥וּמוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיַּֽחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ הַגִּבְעָֽה׃פ

passages.text: And the men of Israel went out to fight against Benjamin and took up their battle positions at Gibeah.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel prepared for battle.
They went out to fight against the tribe of Benjamin.
The men of Israel took up their battle positions.
They arranged themselves for war at Gibeah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וַיַּעַרְכ֨וּ אִתָּ֧ם אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִלְחָמָ֖ה אֶל־ הַגִּבְעָֽה׃

passages.text: And the Benjamites came out of Gibeah and cut down 22,000 Israelites on the battlefield that day.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites were a tribe of Israel.
The Benjamites lived in the city of Gibeah.
On that day, the Benjamites came out from Gibeah.
They fought against the Israelites.
The Benjamites killed 22,000 Israelite men on the battlefield that day.
passages.original: וַיֵּצְא֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן מִן־ הַגִּבְעָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁחִ֨יתוּ בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא שְׁנַ֨יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָֽרְצָה׃

passages.text: But the Israelite army took courage and again took their battle positions in the same place where they had arrayed themselves on the first day.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel were soldiers.
They had just suffered a great loss in battle.
They became strong again.
They took courage.
They prepared for battle once more.
They stood in their battle positions.
They stood in the same place as before.
They stood where they had arranged themselves on the first day.
passages.original: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֥ק הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ לַעֲרֹ֣ךְ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בַּמָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֥רְכוּ שָׁ֖ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

passages.text: They went up and wept before the LORD until evening, inquiring of Him, “Should we again draw near for battle against our brothers the Benjamites?” And the LORD answered, “Go up against them.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were the people of God.
They went up to seek the LORD.
They wept before the LORD until evening.
They asked the LORD a question.
They said, “Should we go again to fight against our brothers, the Benjamites?”
The LORD answered them.
He said, “Go up against them.”
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיִּבְכּ֣וּ לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָה֮ עַד־ הָעֶרֶב֒ וַיִּשְׁאֲל֤וּ בַֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאוֹסִ֗יף לָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן אָחִ֑י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה עֲל֥וּ אֵלָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: On the second day the Israelites advanced against the Benjamites.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were an army of God's people.
The Benjamites were another tribe of Israel.
On the second day, the Israelites moved forward.
They came close to the Benjamites.
They prepared to fight the Benjamites again.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרְב֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

passages.text: That same day the Benjamites came out against them from Gibeah and cut down another 18,000 Israelites, all of them armed with swords.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites were a tribe of Israel.
They lived in the city of Gibeah.
On the second day, the Benjamites came out from Gibeah.
They went out to fight against the Israelites.
The Benjamites attacked the Israelites.
They killed 18,000 Israelite men that day.
All of these Israelite men carried swords.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵא֩ בִנְיָמִ֨ן׀ לִקְרָאתָ֥ם׀ מִֽן־ הַגִּבְעָה֮ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִי֒ וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ֩ בִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל ע֗וֹד שְׁמֹנַ֨ת עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף אִ֖ישׁ אָ֑רְצָה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לְפֵי חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Then the Israelites, all the people, went up to Bethel, where they sat weeping before the LORD. That day they fasted until evening and presented burnt offerings and peace offerings to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
All the Israelites gathered together.
All the people went with them.
They went up to Bethel.
They sat there before the LORD.
They wept before the LORD.
They stayed there that day.
They fasted until evening.
They offered burnt offerings to the LORD.
They offered peace offerings to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ כָל־ בְּנֵי֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל וְכָל־ הָעָ֜ם וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל וַיִּבְכּוּ֙ וַיֵּ֤שְׁבוּ שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּצ֥וּמוּ בַיּוֹם־ הַה֖וּא עַד־ הָעָ֑רֶב וַֽיַּעֲל֛וּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And the Israelites inquired of the LORD. (In those days the ark of the covenant of God was there, and Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, served before it.) The Israelites asked, “Should we again go out to battle against our brothers the Benjamites, or should we stop?” The LORD answered, “Fight, for tomorrow I will deliver them into your hand.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites asked the LORD for guidance.
The ark of the covenant of God was present in those days.
Phinehas was the son of Eleazar.
Eleazar was the son of Aaron.
Phinehas stood before the ark in those days.
The Israelites said, “Should we go out again to fight against our brothers, the Benjamites, or should we stop?”
The LORD said, “Go up.”
The LORD said, “Tomorrow I will give them into your hand.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁאֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּֽיהוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֗ם אֲרוֹן֙ בְּרִ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵֽם׃ וּ֠פִינְחָס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן עֹמֵ֣ד׀ לְפָנָ֗יו בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵם֮ לֵאמֹר֒ הַאוֹסִ֨ף ע֜וֹד לָצֵ֧את לַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה עִם־ בְּנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֥ן אָחִ֖י אִם־ אֶחְדָּ֑ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ עֲל֔וּ כִּ֥י מָחָ֖ר אֶתְּנֶ֥נּוּ בְיָדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: So Israel set up an ambush around Gibeah.
passages.sermon: Israel was the nation of God's people.\r\nIsrael set an ambush.\r\nThey placed the ambush around the city of Gibeah.
passages.original: וַיָּ֤שֶׂם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽרְבִ֔ים אֶל־ הַגִּבְעָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃פ

passages.text: On the third day the Israelites went up against the Benjamites and arrayed themselves against Gibeah as they had done before.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
The Benjamites were one of the tribes of Israel.
On the third day, the Israelites went up against the Benjamites.
They prepared for battle against the city of Gibeah.
They arranged themselves for battle just as they had done before.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲל֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י וַיַּעַרְכ֥וּ אֶל־ הַגִּבְעָ֖ה כְּפַ֥עַם בְּפָֽעַם׃

passages.text: The Benjamites came out against them and were drawn away from the city. They began to attack the people as before, killing about thirty men of Israel in the fields and on the roads, one of which led up to Bethel and the other to Gibeah.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites were a tribe of Israel.
The Benjamites came out to fight the Israelites.
The Benjamites left the city of Gibeah.
The Benjamites began to attack the Israelites.
They attacked just as they had done before.
They killed about thirty men of Israel.
They killed them in the fields.
They also killed them on the roads.
One road led to Bethel.
The other road led to Gibeah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִן֙ לִקְרַ֣את הָעָ֔ם הָנְתְּק֖וּ מִן־ הָעִ֑יר וַיָּחֵ֡לּוּ לְהַכּוֹת֩ מֵהָעָ֨ם חֲלָלִ֜ים כְּפַ֣עַם׀ בְּפַ֗עַם בַּֽמְסִלּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַחַ֜ת עֹלָ֣ה בֵֽית־ אֵ֗ל וְאַחַ֤ת גִּבְעָ֙תָה֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: “We are defeating them as before,” said the Benjamites. But the Israelites said, “Let us retreat and draw them away from the city onto the roads.”
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites spoke.
They said, "We are defeating them as before."
The Benjamites believed they were winning against the Israelites.
The Israelites spoke.
They said, "Let us retreat."
They said, "Let us draw them away from the city onto the roads."
The Israelites planned to lure the Benjamites away from the city.
passages.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן נִגָּפִ֥ים הֵ֛ם לְפָנֵ֖ינוּ כְּבָרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל אָמְר֗וּ נָנ֙וּסָה֙ וּֽנְתַקְּנֻ֔הוּ מִן־ הָעִ֖יר אֶל־ הַֽמְסִלּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: So all the men of Israel got up from their places and arrayed themselves at Baal-tamar, and the Israelites in ambush charged from their positions west of Gibeah.
passages.sermon:
All the men of Israel stood up from where they were.
They gathered together at Baal-tamar.
Some Israelites had hidden in ambush.
These Israelites waited west of Gibeah.
The Israelites in ambush rushed out from their hiding places.
passages.original: וְכֹ֣ל׀ אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל קָ֚מוּ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ וַיַּעַרְכ֖וּ בְּבַ֣עַל תָּמָ֑ר וְאֹרֵ֧ב יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵגִ֥יחַ מִמְּקֹמ֖וֹ מִמַּֽעֲרֵה־ גָֽבַע׃

passages.text: Then 10,000 select men from all Israel made a frontal assault against Gibeah, and the battle was fierce. But the Benjamites did not realize that disaster was upon them.
passages.sermon:
10,000 strong and chosen men came from all Israel.
These men attacked Gibeah directly.
The battle was fierce.
The Benjamites did not know disaster was coming upon them.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ מִנֶּ֨גֶד לַגִּבְעָ֜ה עֲשֶׂרֶת֩ אֲלָפִ֨ים אִ֤ישׁ בָּחוּר֙ מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה כָּבֵ֑דָה וְהֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָדְע֔וּ כִּֽי־ נֹגַ֥עַת עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הָרָעָֽה׃פ

passages.text: The LORD defeated Benjamin in the presence of Israel, and on that day the Israelites slaughtered 25,100 Benjamites, all armed with swords.
passages.sermon:
The LORD fought against the tribe of Benjamin.
The LORD defeated Benjamin while all Israel watched.
On that day, the Israelites attacked the Benjamites.
The Israelites killed 25,100 men from Benjamin.
All these Benjamite men carried swords.
passages.original: וַיִּגֹּ֨ף יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶֽת־ בִּנְיָמִן֮ לִפְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיַּשְׁחִיתוּ֩ בְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּבִנְיָמִן֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף וּמֵאָ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה שֹׁ֥לֵף חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Then the Benjamites realized they had been defeated. Now the men of Israel had retreated before Benjamin because they were relying on the ambush they had set against Gibeah.
passages.sermon: The Benjamites saw that they were defeated.\r\nThe men of Israel had pulled back from Benjamin.\r\nThe Israelites trusted in the ambush they had placed against Gibeah.
passages.original: וַיִּרְא֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן כִּ֣י נִגָּ֑פוּ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל מָקוֹם֙ לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן כִּ֤י בָֽטְחוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֹרֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֖מוּ אֶל־ הַגִּבְעָֽה׃

passages.text: The men in ambush rushed suddenly against Gibeah; they advanced and put the whole city to the sword.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel set an ambush against Gibeah.
These men hid and waited for the right moment.
The ambush group moved quickly.
They rushed toward the city of Gibeah.
They entered the city without delay.
The ambush group attacked the people of Gibeah.
They killed everyone in the city with their swords.
passages.original: וְהָאֹרֵ֣ב הֵחִ֔ישׁוּ וַֽיִּפְשְׁט֖וּ אֶל־ הַגִּבְעָ֑ה וַיִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הָאֹרֵ֔ב וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעִ֖יר לְפִי־ חָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: The men of Israel had arranged a signal with the men in ambush: When they sent up a great cloud of smoke from the city, the men of Israel would turn in the battle. When the Benjamites had begun to strike them down, killing about thirty men of Israel, they said, “They are defeated before us as in the first battle.”
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel made a plan with the men in ambush.
They agreed on a signal.
The signal was a great cloud of smoke rising from the city.
When the men in ambush sent up the smoke, the men of Israel would turn in the battle.
The men of Benjamin began to strike down men of Israel.
They killed about thirty men of Israel.
The men of Benjamin said, “They are defeated before us as in the first battle.”
passages.original: וְהַמּוֹעֵ֗ד הָיָ֛ה לְאִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עִם־ הָאֹרֵ֑ב הֶ֕רֶב לְהַעֲלוֹתָ֛ם מַשְׂאַ֥ת הֶעָשָׁ֖ן מִן־ הָעִֽיר׃ וַיַּהֲפֹ֥ךְ אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וּבִנְיָמִ֡ן הֵחֵל֩ לְהַכּ֨וֹת חֲלָלִ֤ים בְּאִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ אַךְ֩ נִגּ֨וֹף נִגָּ֥ף הוּא֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ כַּמִּלְחָמָ֖ה הָרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: But when the column of smoke began to go up from the city, the Benjamites looked behind them and saw the whole city going up in smoke.
passages.sermon:
A column of smoke began to rise from the city.
The smoke went up like a pillar.
The men of Benjamin looked behind them.
They saw the whole city going up in smoke toward the sky.
passages.original: וְהַמַּשְׂאֵ֗ת הֵחֵ֛לָּה לַעֲל֥וֹת מִן־ הָעִ֖יר עַמּ֣וּד עָשָׁ֑ן וַיִּ֤פֶן בִּנְיָמִן֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וְהִנֵּ֛ה עָלָ֥ה כְלִיל־ הָעִ֖יר הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה׃

passages.text: Then the men of Israel turned back on them, and the men of Benjamin were terrified when they realized that disaster had come upon them.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel fought against the men of Benjamin.
The men of Israel turned back toward the men of Benjamin.
The men of Benjamin saw what was happening.
The men of Benjamin became very afraid.
The men of Benjamin realized that disaster had come upon them.
passages.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָפַ֔ךְ וַיִּבָּהֵ֖ל אִ֣ישׁ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן כִּ֣י רָאָ֔ה כִּֽי־ נָגְעָ֥ה עָלָ֖יו הָרָעָֽה׃

passages.text: So they fled before the men of Israel toward the wilderness, but the battle overtook them, and the men coming out of the cities struck them down there.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites saw the men of Israel.
The Benjamites turned away from the men of Israel.
The Benjamites ran toward the road to the wilderness.
The battle caught up with the Benjamites.
Men came out from the cities.
These men struck down the Benjamites in the midst of the battle.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ לִפְנֵ֨י אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה הִדְבִּיקָ֑תְהוּ וַאֲשֶׁר֙ מֵהֶ֣עָרִ֔ים מַשְׁחִיתִ֥ים אוֹת֖וֹ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃

passages.text: They surrounded the Benjamites, pursued them, and easily overtook them in the vicinity of Gibeah on the east.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel fought against the tribe of Benjamin.
The men of Israel surrounded the Benjamites.
The men of Israel chased the Benjamites.
The men of Israel caught up with the Benjamites easily.
This happened near Gibeah.
This happened on the east side of Gibeah.
passages.original: כִּתְּר֤וּ אֶת־ בִּנְיָמִן֙ הִרְדִיפֻ֔הוּ מְנוּחָ֖ה הִדְרִיכֻ֑הוּ עַ֛ד נֹ֥כַח הַגִּבְעָ֖ה מִמִּזְרַח־ שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃

passages.text: And 18,000 Benjamites fell, all men of valor.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Benjamin fought in battle.\r\nEighteen thousand men from Benjamin died.\r\nAll these men were strong warriors.
passages.original: וַֽיִּפְּלוּ֙ מִבִּנְיָמִ֔ן שְׁמֹנָֽה־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף אִ֑ישׁ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־ חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: Then the Benjamites turned and fled toward the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, and Israel cut down 5,000 men on the roads. And they overtook them at Gidom and struck down 2,000 more.
passages.sermon:
The Benjamites turned away.
They fled into the wilderness.
They ran toward the rock of Rimmon.
The men of Israel chased them.
Israel killed 5,000 Benjamites on the roads.
Israel caught up with the Benjamites at Gidom.
Israel killed 2,000 more Benjamites at Gidom.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ וַיָּנֻ֤סוּ הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ אֶל־ סֶ֣לַע הָֽרִמּ֔וֹן וַיְעֹֽלְלֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּֽמְסִלּ֔וֹת חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּדְבִּ֤יקוּ אַחֲרָיו֙ עַד־ גִּדְעֹ֔ם וַיַּכּ֥וּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אַלְפַּ֥יִם אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: That day 25,000 Benjamite swordsmen fell, all men of valor.
passages.sermon: On that day, 25,000 men from the tribe of Benjamin died.\r\nAll of these men carried swords.\r\nAll of them were strong and brave warriors.
passages.original: וַיְהִי֩ כָל־ הַנֹּ֨פְלִ֜ים מִבִּנְיָמִ֗ן עֶשְׂרִים֩ וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה אֶ֥לֶף אִ֛ישׁ שֹׁ֥לֵֽף חֶ֖רֶב בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֶֽת־ כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁי־ חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: But 600 men turned and fled into the wilderness to the rock of Rimmon, where they stayed four months.
passages.sermon:
Six hundred men from the tribe of Benjamin turned and ran away.
They fled into the wilderness.
They went to the rock of Rimmon.
These six hundred men stayed at the rock of Rimmon.
They remained there for four months.
passages.original: וַיִּפְנ֞וּ וַיָּנֻ֤סוּ הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ אֶל־ סֶ֣לַע הָֽרִמּ֔וֹן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּסֶ֣לַע רִמּ֔וֹן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: And the men of Israel turned back against the other Benjamites and put to the sword all the cities, including the animals and everything else they found. And they burned down all the cities in their path.
passages.sermon:
The men of Israel acted as a united group.
They turned back toward the people of Benjamin.
They attacked the Benjamites with their swords.
They killed every living thing they found in the cities.
They killed people and animals alike.
They destroyed everything they found.
They set fire to every city they found.
passages.original: וְאִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל שָׁ֣בוּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י בִנְיָמִן֙ וַיַּכּ֣וּם לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב מֵעִ֤יר מְתֹם֙ עַד־ בְּהֵמָ֔ה עַ֖ד כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֑א גַּ֛ם כָּל־ הֶעָרִ֥ים הַנִּמְצָא֖וֹת שִׁלְּח֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃פ
